verdict.rationale: Algolia's Search API is documented to "search, configure, and manage your indices and records" using header-based app ID and API key auth, with official clients in many languages. A scriptable CLI is aimed at CI workflows and has an agent skill for managing indices, settings, rules, and synonyms, and an official MCP server is documented, so the create-index, add-records, and query loop is reachable programmatically. The caveats are that CLI auth opens a browser sign-in, and the MCP server is described only for search, analytics, and recommendations rather than writes. Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end walkthrough of create index, add records, and query via CLI or MCP; evidence of MCP write/ingestion tools; headless API-key provisioning without the browser or dashboard; a discoverable OpenAPI spec; independent hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the loop.
